title: Raise the single-ride cap to $30 and the lost-bike fee to $150
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Change

Two fee ceilings move up together in this one:

- A ride can no longer run past $30.00 total.
- A ride that closes as lost now carries a $150.00 fee.

Links GW-162 and GW-163.

## Testing

Unit cases for both ceilings updated to the new figures; full pricing and lost-bikes suites pass.

comments.author: dana.whitlock
comments.body: We moved off $25.00 because at that ceiling casual riders could just keep a bike out all day, and the busiest stations were empty by noon. $30.00 was the number that kept a full-day rider from coming out ahead of paying by the minute, without pricing out anyone doing a normal errand run.
